name: ac-systematic-review-conduct
description: Running a systematic review as a protocol before it is a document: the question in PICO form, eligibility fixed before the search, the search log and coverage grid, dual screening and inter-rater agreement, extraction forms and piloting, risk-of-bias assessment with a named tool, grey literature and trial registers, the PRISMA flow kept live, protocol registration and amendments, and the conduct audit trail. It runs the review's machinery; it never writes the report and never decides the conclusion. Use when asking "systematic review protocol", "PICO question", "dual screening", "kappa", "extraction form", "risk of bias tool", "PROSPERO", "search strategy log", "grey literature", "PRISMA flow diagram", "scoping versus systematic", "Cochrane handbook". Not for writing the review as a document (ac-academic-writing), not for open-corpus research hunts without a protocol (ac-deep-researcher), not for attacking a finished corpus (ac-adversarial-corpus-challenge).
